description: This file implements a benchmarking wrapper around SkCanvas, capturing drawing commands and their parameters into a JSON-like structure for profiling or analysis. It defines classes and methods for serializing Skia drawing operations and managing command records.

classes.name: FlagsBuilder
classes.description: Helper class for building flag strings with separators.

classes.name: BenchmarkingCanvas
classes.description: A subclass of SkCanvas that records drawing commands and parameters for benchmarking purposes.

classes.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::AutoOp
classes.description: Helper class that records a drawing operation's command and parameters, measuring execution time.

methods.name: AsValue
methods.description: Serializes various Skia types and parameters into base::Value for JSON output.

methods.name: FlagsBuilder::addFlag
methods.description: Adds a flag name to the string if the flag value is true.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::BenchmarkingCanvas
methods.description: Constructor that wraps an existing SkCanvas for benchmarking.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::CommandCount
methods.description: Returns the number of recorded commands.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::Commands
methods.description: Returns the list of recorded command objects.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::GetTime
methods.description: Returns the execution time of a command at a given index.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::getSaveLayerStrategy
methods.description: Records a save layer command with parameters.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::didConcat44
methods.description: Records a concatenation of transformation matrix.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::onClipRRect
methods.description: Records a clip rounded rectangle operation.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::onDrawRRect
methods.description: Records a draw rounded rectangle operation.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::onDrawDRRect
methods.description: Records a draw difference of rounded rectangles.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::onDrawImageRect2
methods.description: Records a draw image with source and destination rects.

methods.name: BenchmarkingCanvas::onDrawTextBlob
methods.description: Records a draw text blob operation.
